_purpose: The declaration half of the design completion gate (scripts/govtech/design-completion-gate.mjs, OPS-17 G-146). Maps every surface in the SHIPPED nav to the design folder that covers it, or to the named ruling that excludes it. The gate cross-checks this file against BOTH the product's own nav constants and the _design/ folder inventory, so it cannot drift silently in either direction.
_why: Coverage is the one question a folder count cannot answer. 48 boards across 11 folders reads as a lot of design and says nothing about whether the surfaces a city actually clicks are drawn. This file is what turns a count into a coverage claim.
_rule: A surface is covered when it has a design folder, or excluded when it carries a ruling with a date. There is no third state. 'Not started' is an uncovered surface and the gate says so.

assets.excluded: G-24 stays at zero until a named ingest (_smartcity_masters/32_smartcity_asset_management.md). Drawing it now is drawing wallpaper.

connections.excluded: Operator ruling: engineering thought before design. It ships as a 75-row function-homes register, baked and fixed-point tested. See _inbox/2026-09-15_connections_surface_findings.md.

crossCutting.smartcity-map-dock: The city map as a persistent rail. Not a nav surface; it appears inside others. Dispatched G-128.
crossCutting.smartcity-flood-study: A Development services tab and a cross-department capability. G-125, G-129.
crossCutting.smartcity-finance-filings: The Localgov filings tab inside the Finance lens. Under AMEND, G-138.
crossCutting.plan-review-departments: Parallel departmental review. May be shown, cannot be built until G-144.
crossCutting.plan-review: The original console set. Three plan review designs exist and which one a city is shown is still owed.
crossCutting.smartcity-place-tab: Superseded 2026-09-14 by smartcity-map-dock. Kept as the record of the option not taken.

_instrumentRule: A design that has been ratified, approved or put in front of anyone carries an adversarial read run as a file. A DRAFT may not have one yet; anything past DRAFT must. This is the rule the design thread earned on 2026-09-15 and it was never applied backwards.
